mapper.select: SELECT wm.id,wm.user_id,u.user_name,u.phone_number,wm.department,wm.title,wm.role,wm.status,wm.created_at,wm.last_active_at FROM workspace_members wm JOIN users u ON u.id=wm.user_id WHERE wm.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members access WHERE access.workspace_id=wm.workspace_id AND access.user_id=#{userId} AND access.status='ACTIVE') ORDER BY wm.created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_members SET role=#{role} WHERE id=#{memberId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND role<>'OWNER' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND role IN('OWNER','ADMIN') AND status='ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_members(workspace_id,user_id,role) VALUES(#{workspaceId},#{userId},#{role}) ON CONFLICT (workspace_id,user_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO workspace_invitations(workspace_id,phone_number,department,title,invite_note,role,token_hash,invited_by,expires_at) SELECT #{workspaceId},#{phoneNumber},#{department},#{title},#{inviteNote},#{role},#{tokenHash},#{userId},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '7 days' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND role IN('OWNER','ADMIN') AND status='ACTIVE')
